caption: ADP, LLC v. Mork
citation_line: ADP, LLC v. Mork, No. 2:17-cv-04613; appeal consolidated in ADP, LLC v. Rafferty, 923 F.3d 113 (3d Cir. 2019)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Cecchi denied preliminary enforcement of restrictive covenants that ADP required high-performing employees to accept as a condition of restricted-stock awards, treating the covenants as unenforceable in their then-present form.
qualification_rationale: The litigation became an important New Jersey restrictive-covenant authority concerning legitimate business interests, employee hardship and judicial narrowing of overbroad covenants.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit vacated and remanded in a precedential opinion. It held that the covenants were not unenforceable in their entirety, recognized ADP’s legitimate interests, and directed the district courts to consider blue-penciling their scope.
